effect_description_eng:
＜Iceclad＞ (Other than against Security Digimon, compare the number of digivolution cards instead of DP in this Digimon's battles.)
＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 [Suzune Kazuki] or level 4 or lower [Ice-Snow] trait Digimon card from your hand without paying the cost.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When other Digimon are played or digivolve, trash any 3 digivolution cards from your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon with no digivolution cards can't suspend until their turn ends.
